Two translucent DualShock 4 controllers: one blue, one red.
Sony and PS logos are visible on the console in photo 0.
Watermark 'GADGET WORLD' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on the image.

Origin cannot be determined from photos.

proof_requests: Video of the console booting up and reaching the home screen.
Photo of the system information screen showing storage capacity and firmware version.
Video demonstrating the disc drive working.
Close-up photos of the console without the plastic wrap to check for physical damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Sony PlayStation 4 (Original model) with two controllers. It will be priced at its worst-case functional state due to lack of proof of operation.
